# Riverbend Nonprofit Network theory of change: portfolio

As of 2026-09-30.

| Pathway | Status | Outcomes by status | Confidence | Measurement cost | Free data | Reports to | Open decisions |
|---------|--------|--------------------|------------|------------------|-----------|------------|----------------|
| Learning Exchange (`pw-learning`) | At risk | 1 at risk · 4 on track | 0.18 | 18.46 min/week · 16 questions/year · 5 indicator(s) | 2 of 5 (40%) | Funders, Members, Network board | — |
| Shared Services (`pw-shared`) | Not started | 6 not started | 0.14 | 17.31 min/week · 6 questions/year · 5 indicator(s) | 2 of 5 (40%) | Funders, Members, Network board | Should pooled services move from free trial to member fees in 2027? |
| Civic Voice (`pw-civic`) | At risk | 3 at risk · 1 not started · 1 unmeasured | 0.12 | 9.23 min/week · 0 questions/year · 3 indicator(s) | 2 of 4 (50%) | County planning office, Funders, Members, Network board | Should the network hire a part-time civic liaison for the county channel? |

_How to read this._ A pathway's status is the worst pathway status among its outcomes. Confidence is the mean confidence of those outcomes' routes to impact. Free data is the share of the pathway's selected indicators collected passively or derived from other indicators. The table compares pathways; it does not rank them.

_Method._ Status compares progress with what the dated targets call for, within a tolerance of 10%; an outcome takes the worst of its indicators. Confidence in a link is 0.4 × evidence + 0.4 × assumptions + 0.2 × rationale, from 0 to 1; a route to impact multiplies its links' confidence.
